== devices/adc_bridge.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix A
  category delay
  provenance "xschem adc_bridge.sym"
  xfp a13c6f68c7216021

pin s in -30 0
pin d out 30 0

param adc_bridge_model adc_buff
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} [ {s} ] [ {d} ] {adc_bridge_model}"

line -30 0 30 0
  layer 4
line -10 -5 10 0
  layer 4
line -10 5 10 0
  layer 4

stext -25 -10 R0 {name}
  size 0.12
  layer 3
stext 0 -10 R0 {adc_bridge_model}
  size 0.12
  layer 3
